texts: Added the new identities, E.G.O, announcer, theme pack, choice events, encounters, and gifts for the 10th Walpurgisnacht update. Identity/E.G.O summaries and gift annotations (effects/triggers) to come later.
Updated some of the tips for some achievements.

Changed the short answer checker for the Community Trivia Quiz to be a little stricter. The checker allows for some leeway with typos, but it incorrectly ended up allowing some wrong answers when it comes to numbers. I've changed it to make sure that numbers have to be exact.
